correctness.rationale: The normalized tensor-Hessian differentiated Legendre kernel produces a Klein-four two-by-two block-circulant Gram matrix. Exact symbolic block comparison verifies its 2+3+3 eigenvalue decomposition. Independent rational harmonic-polynomial evaluation agrees through degree seven; rational Legendre recurrences prove finite degrees through 24; a fully quantified Bernstein-ODE estimate makes each eigenbranch strictly positive from degree 25. A tetrahedrally invariant cubic xyz is annihilated and rank six proves its exact one-dimensional kernel. Both embedded checkers successfully replayed.

value.rationale: The spin-two trace-free Hessian is the natural quadrupolar second-jet observable of spherical harmonics. On a canonical four-node tetrahedral sampling set, the theorem gives an all-degree three-eigenbranch Gram spectrum, the unique cubic blind mode and a sharp permanent interpolation degree threshold. The exact invariant and its unexpected isolated kernel support practical rank/conditioning calculations beyond elementary normalization or a finite table.
